author: Cynthesis
body:
Recently, I just got a new PC and one of the things I can do now is play lots of Steam games. So it led me to wonder: what does everyone else in this community play on Steam?

Here are some of the games I play often, so let me know if we have any in common :)
  • Dota 2
  • Portal & Portal 2
  • Antichamber
  • FTL: Faster Than Light
  • Audiosurf
